content.rendered:
Arch was entrusted with the complete construction and fit-out of Memo restaurant. Our scope of work included:

  • Construction: Foundation, structural work, and building envelope.
  • Fit-out: Interior partitions, ceilings, flooring, and MEP (mechanical, electrical, and plumbing) systems.
  • Finishes: High-quality materials such as natural stone, custom-made woodwork, and bespoke lighting fixtures.
  • Interior design: A visually stunning and functional space that reflects the restaurant’s brand identity.
